description: This header file declares utility functions for reading from and writing to file descriptors, including functions for reading exact amounts of data, reading binary data, and sending/receiving data over sockets. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and references a shared file descriptor class.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until it is closed or errors, storing all data in the provided string buffer.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until reading buf->size() bytes or an error occurs.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until reading buf->size() bytes or an error occurs, for a vector buffer.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly 'size' bytes from a SharedFD into a character buffer.

methods.name: ReadExactBinary
methods.description: Template function that reads sizeof(T) bytes from a SharedFD into a binary data object.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a std::string_view to a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a vector buffer to a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes exactly 'size' bytes from a character buffer to a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAllBinary
methods.description: Template function that writes sizeof(T) bytes from a binary data object to a SharedFD.

methods.name: SendAll
methods.description: Sends the contents of a string message through a socket, checking for errors.

methods.name: RecvAll
methods.description: Receives a specified number of bytes from a socket, returning the data or an empty string on error.
